observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Gamitin ang nasuring pamamaraan at malinis na gamit; itala ang bilang, yunit at oras at iulat ang concern.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Uses the reviewed method, avoids contaminating equipment, records value/units and escalates concern.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Itala ang resultang hindi nasukat o gumamit ng maruming aparato.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Record a value that was not measured or use unclean equipment.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Gamitin ang nasuring pamamaraan at malinis na gamit; itala ang bilang, yunit at oras at iulat ang concern.
levels.kaya_na_en: Uses the reviewed method, avoids contaminating equipment, records value/units and escalates concern.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang pangunahing hakbang ngunit kailangan ng paalala o pagwawasto sa pag-follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Completes the main step but needs a prompt or correction on follow-up.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Itala ang resultang hindi nasukat o gumamit ng maruming aparato.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Record a value that was not measured or use unclean equipment.
